name: forge-agent
description: A lightweight VS Code coding agent powered by TrueForge with a local MCP workspace server.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/security.js && node --check src/tools.js && node --check src/temp-mcp-bridge.js
scripts.inspect: node -e "const token = require('fs').readFileSync('.forge-token','utf8').trim(); fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp', {method:'POST', headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+token, 'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify({jsonrpc:'2.0', id:1, method:'tools/list', params:{}})}).then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>console.log(JSON.stringify(d,null,2)));"

commands.title: Forge Agent: Connect Temporary MCP Bridge

forgeAgent.agentName.description: Name of the saved TrueForge agent configured with the MCP workspace server.

forgeAgent.token.description: Optional TrueForge bearer token for authenticated servers.
